page_title: JUV 3-0 NAP | Juventus v Napoli 25/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Maurizio Mariani is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' Here is a change. Kenan Yildiz is going off and Luciano Spalletti gives the last tactical orders to Federico Gatti (Juventus).
87' Substitution. Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) in, Manuel Locatelli out.
86' 3 - 0 Filip Kostic (Juventus) finds the back of the net with a precise, technical shot into the bottom right corner. A brilliant individual effort.
86' Wonderful movement by Juventus. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
83' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) is penalised for holding. Maurizio Mariani signals a set piece. Juventus will take a free kick near the side line.
79' Substitution. Antonio Vergara makes way for Romelu Lukaku (Napoli).
77' 2 - 0 Goal - 2:0! Fabio Miretti tees up Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Alex Meret.
76' Luciano Spalletti has decided to substitute Jonathan David and he is replaced by Fabio Miretti (Juventus).
74' That will be all from Miguel Gutierrez who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Sam Beukema (Napoli).
73' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Antonio Vergara (Napoli).
71' Filip Kostic (Juventus) commits a foul during an attacking move. It's a free kick to Napoli, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
70' Antonio Conte has decided to make a change. Giovane (Napoli) replaces Eljif Elmas.
66' Juan Cabal (Juventus) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
65' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Juventus, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
64' A pass from Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is intercepted by Michele Di Gregorio and the move breaks down.
60' The game has come to an end for Andrea Cambiaso. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Filip Kostic (Juventus).
60' Luciano Spalletti prepares a substitution. Francisco Conceicao is replaced by Juan Cabal (Juventus).
59' Neat passing move from Juventus in order to create new attacking opportunities.

58' Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) unleashed a mid-range free kick, but his promising strike goes well wide of the left post. It will be a goal kick. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
57' Today's referee Maurizio Mariani rightly decides to book Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) for his harsh tackle.

55' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
54' Great teamplay by Napoli as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
53' That's unlucky! Jonathan David (Juventus) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
52' Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

52' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The linesman makes the right call and Napoli will have a corner.
50' Jonathan David (Juventus) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. A free kick has been awarded to Napoli.
50' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Napoli.
46' Referee Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Antonio Vergara (Napoli) makes a slide tackle, but referee Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul. Juventus have a free kick.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle, Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
45+1' Wow, what an escape. Khephren Thuram (Juventus) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Napoli seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
44' Weston McKennie (Juventus) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Maurizio Mariani who sees an offensive foul. Napoli are awarded a free kick.
43' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Scott McTominay (Napoli). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
40' PENALTY APPEAL by Napoli, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
40' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
37' The Juventus players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

35' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) beats a couple of players and hammers in a low shot from mid-range towards the middle of the goal. The keeper is caught unaware but still pulls off a great save to deny the effort.
34' Maurizio Mariani shows a yellow card to Juan Jesus (Napoli) for a tough tackle.
32' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
28' A cross from Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
25' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
24' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Juventus players have a reason to celebrate!
24' The Juventus players halt their celebrations as referee Maurizio Mariani makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
22' 1 - 0 Jonathan David (Juventus) changes the scoreline after getting on the end of a brilliant pass and firing a precise shot that goes inside the right post!
22' A pass by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

21' What a great touch by Khephren Thuram (Juventus)! He picks up a precise pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot on goal. His effort, however, only rattles the right post. What an unlucky moment for him. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.

20' That was a nice football moment. Antonio Vergara (Napoli) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the right post. Michele Di Gregorio guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
19' The Napoli players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

17' Weston McKennie (Juventus) pounces on the cross into the centre of the box, but hangs his head in shame after sending his header well wide of the left post when the keeper was on his backside. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.

14' Juventus slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.

13' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
12' Bremer (Juventus) commits a rough challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Napoli will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
11' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
11' The ball goes out of play. Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
10' Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Good work from Napoli as they win a corner.
7' A pass by Eljif Elmas (Napoli) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

3' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Napoli are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Juventus.
1' The match has just started.
Juventus will kick the game off.
Maurizio Mariani will supervise the game today.
